posts.cooked:
I don't know about anyone else, but I'm going to need a lot of help remembering specific questions from specific episodes.  I have a candidate for "saddest," but the others are hard.  "Funniest" is hard because the jokes usually aren't closely tied to the episode contents.  "Most revealing" is hard because the revealing ones are the ones where C&A go off on huge tangents to the point where you don't even remember what the question was, plus often they'll skip something in the overview just because someone asked a question about it and they would have said the same stuff anyway.  I tend not to pay attention to fan theories.

Anyone have any thoughts?

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Jeysie:

Like they say in the episode, reading WalkingTarget’s summaries on the wiki should give enough of a memory jog to know which bits of the episodes to relisten to make sure you got the specific details.

WalkingTarget’s summaries are great for facts, but for the most part they don’t cover the questions themselves.  When they do include the questions, they’re boiled down to the bare amount of information you need to understand the answer. Any jokes or flavor are almost always left out.  Incorrect fan theories do usually make it in, but going through over 50 episodes to find them is a lot, and I don’t remember many.

 

Anyone remember when the Cult of Gruum wrote in?  That was certainly one of my favorites.

Edit: Oh, man, I didn’t realize how limiting 2018 really is.  No Guise, no Southwest Sentinels, no Ambuscade.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
The closest is the Mission Deck listing: https://sentinelswiki.com/index.php?title=OblivAeon/MissionDeck

Heroes

  • Cold War
  • Citizen Storm
  • Arataki
  • Lucky Break
  • Seraph
  • Omni-Unity
  • Cursor
  • El Mejor Legado
  • The Everyman
  • The Chronoist

Villains

  • Hellion
  • The Red Menace

There's also a few people on Be the Gate who don't show up in the actual Mission Deck. There's a good-aligned Akash (though I'm guessing that's probably the Inversiverse one), Wind Walker, what seems to be a good-aligned Ermine, and a Sky-Scraper dressed like Tempest and wielding what seems to be lightning. (The others are Seraph, Lucky Break, and Cursor.) I dunno yet if they'll also be covered in the episode or not.
